scripts.build: bun scripts/gen-templates-bundle.ts && tsc && rm -rf dist/templates dist/scripts && cp -r templates dist/templates && cp -r scripts dist/scripts && bun build --bundle --target node --format esm --outfile dist/scripts/strict-spec-driven.js src/strict-spec-cli.ts && bun build --bundle --target node --format esm --outfile dist/scripts/strict-spec-driven-mcp.js src/mcp/entrypoint.ts
scripts.bundle: mkdir -p dist/scripts && bun build --bundle --target node --format esm --outfile dist/scripts/strict-spec-driven.js src/strict-spec-cli.ts && bun build --bundle --target node --format esm --outfile dist/scripts/strict-spec-driven-mcp.js src/mcp/entrypoint.ts
scripts.validate-skills: bun run build:bundle && node dist/scripts/strict-spec-driven.js validate-skills
